prepared_mappings.applicability: Determination of a criminal charge or rights/obligations in a suit at law. An adverse ruling alone does not establish bias. Assess special/military proceedings and law establishing jurisdiction; core independence/impartiality cannot be displaced by convenience.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Court/tribunal access and relevant proceedings, including criminal charges and suits at law. Different treatment is not automatically unlawful; examine objective reasons, actual disadvantage and access barriers. Do not equate equal arms with identical roles.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Hearing and judgment in determination of a criminal charge or suit at law; determine hearing type, as not every pretrial/appeal step requires a public hearing. Press/public may be excluded for morals, public order, national security in a democratic society, private lives, or strictly necessary special circumstances where publicity prejudices justice. Judgment exceptions include juvenile interests or matrimonial/child guardianship disputes.

prepared_mappings.applicability: Preparation for a criminal charge, hearings and relevant defence steps. Adequacy depends on complexity, access and circumstances. Requests for additional time and reasoned rulings matter; document volume alone is not adequacy.

prepared_mappings.applicability: Criminal defence; distinguish custodial/investigation guarantees under Article 9 and applicable domestic law. Assigned assistance depends on interests of justice and lack of means for free assistance. Self-representation restrictions require objective sufficiently serious reasons; attributed counsel errors require case-specific responsibility analysis.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Criminal trial and defence participation. Proceedings in absence can be permissible in specific circumstances after sufficient notice and opportunity; verify steps informing the accused and justification, not absence alone.

prepared_mappings.applicability: Criminal trial and material defence evidence requests. This is not an unlimited right to call every witness. Identify relevance, requests, refusals, reasons and disadvantage.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Criminal proceedings when courtroom language cannot be understood/spoken. Nationality or multilingual setting alone does not prove need or adequacy. This right does not require proceedings in the preferred language where the court language is sufficiently understood.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Obtaining/use of statements in a criminal process, including earlier investigation where relevant to trial. Voluntary admission is not automatically prohibited. Distinguish Article 7 coercion and Article 9 detention guarantees; evaluate burden and exclusion of alleged coerced statements.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Criminal charge through final adjudication/appeal. Assess complexity, accused conduct and administrative/judicial handling. Elapsed time or a procedural deadline alone does not establish undue delay; custody increases need for expedition.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: After criminal conviction/sentence and relevant higher review. Guarantee is substantive, not merely a formal check. Civil review is not automatically within Article 14(5); examine applicable special procedures and access to reasoned judgment/record.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Criminal proceedings involving a juvenile at the relevant event date. Age and domestic juvenile status require verification. Juvenile-specific procedure/rehabilitation and diversion where appropriate are distinct from assuming identical adult procedure.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Later criminal proceedings following a potentially final conviction/acquittal for the same offence. Verify finality/same offence/same jurisdiction. Higher review and narrowly justified resumption on exceptional grounds are distinct; the Covenant does not automatically prohibit prosecutions in different national jurisdictions.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: After qualifying reversal/pardon and punishment following final criminal conviction. Ordinary acquittal, dismissal or reversal alone is insufficient. Examine final conviction, punishment, newly discovered fact, conclusive miscarriage and whether non-disclosure was wholly/partly attributable to the person.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Do not presume expression was involved in every prosecution. Identify conduct and restriction; Article 20 duties and other rights may also require analysis.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: First establish expression and restriction. Citation of a statute alone does not settle foreseeability or its application.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: An asserted aim is a government position, not proof of necessity or legitimacy in the particular application. Missing government reasons remain unknown.

prepared_mappings.next_verification: Inspect the relevant evidence and applicable standard.
prepared_mappings.applicability: Assess actual expression, aim, harm, penalty and alternatives. A restriction is not automatically unlawful; a legal basis and aim do not automatically establish necessity.
